genesis.5.p1.b1.text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness. Male and female He created them

genesis.5.p1.b2.text: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.

genesis.5.p1.b3.text: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.

genesis.5.p1.b4.text: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died. … So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.

genesis.5.p2.b5.text: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died. … So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.

genesis.5.p2.b6.text: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

genesis.5.p2.b7.text: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.

genesis.5.p3.b8.text: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.

genesis.5.p3.b9.text: May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.

genesis.5.p3.b10.text: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
